llmResponse.agenda_changes: Two changes to agenda announced during 'Changes to the Agenda' segment: (1) Item 12.5 (KIPP Excelencia agreement - Resolution 23) moved from Action Items to Consent section; (2) Item 16.1 (Brenna's teacher pay presentation from Labor Association Comments) moved to directly after Public Comment for medical reasons.
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: I move that we approve the Consent to the Agenda as amended to include 12.5. Thank you. Second. All those in favor? Aye.
